mechanism: Pyrazinamide can cause hyperuricemia and gout, while diltiazem may increase serum uric acid levels; additionally, pyrazinamide may inhibit diltiazem metabolism via CYP3A4, potentially increasing diltiazem concentrations.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels and gout symptoms; consider alternative antituberculous therapy or monitor diltiazem levels and cardiac parameters if concurrent use is necessary.
